# Databricks notebook source
# MAGIC %md
# MAGIC ## Load transactions data

# COMMAND ----------

# Read CSV files from workspace
file1_path = "/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpabddfc86/data/transactions_export_1.csv"
file2_path = "/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpabddfc86/data/transactions_export_2.csv"

# COMMAND ----------

# Read both CSV files
df1 = spark.read.csv(file1_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)
df2 = spark.read.csv(file2_path, header=True, inferSchema=True)

# COMMAND ----------

# Union and deduplicate by row_id
# Since row_id uniquely identifies a row, we keep only one copy of each
combined_df = df1.unionByName(df2)

# Deduplicate: when there are duplicates, keep the first occurrence
# But we need to handle the case where the same row_id appears in both files
# According to schema.md, the second file is a re-delivery that includes the tail of the first
# So we should keep all unique row_ids
dedup_df = combined_df.dropDuplicates(["row_id"])

# COMMAND ----------

# Show counts
print(f"df1 count: {df1.count()}")
print(f"df2 count: {df2.count()}")
print(f"combined count: {combined_df.count()}")
print(f"deduplicated count: {dedup_df.count()}")

# COMMAND ----------

# Write to Unity Catalog table
catalog_name = "workspace"
schema_name = "mlpabddfc86"
table_name = "transactions30b87b"

full_table_name = f"{catalog_name}.{schema_name}.{table_name}"

# Write as Delta table
dedup_df.write.format("delta").saveAsTable(full_table_name)

# COMMAND ----------

# Create online table for low-latency access
online_table_name = f"{catalog_name}.{schema_name}.{table_name}_online"

# Use the feature store or online tables API
# Actually, let's use the online tables creation
spark.sql(f"""
CREATE ONLINE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {online_table_name} 
SOURCE TABLE {full_table_name}
""")

# COMMAND ----------

print(f"Table {full_table_name} created successfully")
print(f"Online table {online_table_name} created successfully")
EOF
